rect.data-content:
dispatch init and plan
waves by deps and file overlap

Analyse and agree seams
story traces, contract tests

Commit and spec feedback
spec-feedback rows, no spec edit

Run the gates
dependency-check always, rest by list

Refresh the story branch
merge the moved invocation branch

Drift rows to owner, reviewer
spec-feedback report, two passes

Reviewer files BUG
owner developer-agent, wave goes on

Route the QA findings
test-strategy agent per open QA finding

Human reviews and commits
story ID in the subject

Close the story
drift rows, then QA findings

gate reports in .current-work/<gate>/
QA-NNNN for unresolved mutants

QA-NNNN resolved or to planning agent
QA strategy owner table

finding-classification (accepted)
computed severity, minor findings to a register

review-loop-cap (open)
stops after 3 passes, then the human decides

manual-mode-gates (draft)
both modes run the gates through story-gates
